import-subitems-monday.title: How to Import Subitems in Monday.com (2026 Step-by-Step Guide)
import-subitems-monday.description: Monday.com doesn't support importing subitems natively. Learn how to import subitems from CSV into monday.com in 5 steps using the free Monday.com Inspector Chrome extension.
import-subitems-monday.h1: How to Import Subitems in Monday.com (2026 Step-by-Step Guide)
import-subitems-monday.lead: Monday.com's native import only creates top-level items — it has no built-in support for importing subitems and no clean handling of multi-level boards. This guide shows you how to import both from a CSV or Excel file into any monday.com board using the free Monday.com Inspector Chrome extension. Updated for v1.6.3 with the full-page Importer, multi-level board awareness, and smart error recovery.

monday-import-images-from-excel.title: Bulk Import Images from Excel into Monday.com (2026 Guide)
monday-import-images-from-excel.description: Monday.com has no native way to bulk-import images from Excel into a File column. This free Chrome extension extracts embedded images from .xlsx, anchors them to rows, and uploads them to monday.com items at scale — no manual drag-and-drop required.
monday-import-images-from-excel.h1: Bulk Import Images from Excel into Monday.com
monday-import-images-from-excel.lead: Monday.com has no native way to bulk-upload images from Excel into a File column. If you have product photos, screenshots, signatures, or before/after shots sitting in a spreadsheet, the only built-in path is dragging each image into each item by hand. This guide shows you how to do it in one pass — using the free Monday.com Inspector extension's new Image Importer.
